device.coverage: Profiles S / T (streaming), G (recording), A / C (access control)

methods.notes: Real discovery is WS-Discovery: multicast a Probe to 239.255.255.250:3702 (UDP); devices reply with their service endpoint URL and a device UUID. Then GetProfiles + GetStreamUri yield the RTSP URL. See device.notes.

device.name: ONVIF (Open Network Video Interface Forum)
device.notes:
ONVIF is the open standard most IP cameras, doorbells and NVRs implement for discovery, device management and video streaming. A concrete camera spec should cite this file for the discovery + stream-URI mechanism rather than restating it; the device itself carries only its vendor-specific quirks.
DISCOVERY (WS-Discovery): a Probe is multicast over UDP to the reserved address 239.255.255.250:3702; ONVIF devices reply (unicast ProbeMatch) with their service endpoint URL, device type and a device UUID.
DEVICE SERVICE: the Device Management service is at the HTTP subaddress /onvif/device_service. SOAP over HTTP; ports are typically 80 (management) and 554 (RTSP media).
WSDL SERVICE NAMESPACES:
  Device Management  http://www.onvif.org/ver10/device/wsdl
  Media              http://www.onvif.org/ver10/media/wsdl
  PTZ                http://www.onvif.org/ver20/ptz/wsdl
  Imaging            http://www.onvif.org/ver20/imaging/wsdl
  Events             http://www.onvif.org/ver10/events/wsdl

KEY SOAP OPERATIONS: GetDeviceInformation, GetServices / GetCapabilities, GetProfiles, GetStreamUri, GetSnapshotUri.
GETTING A STREAM: call the media service GetStreamUri(ProfileToken=<token>, StreamSetup={Stream: RTP-Unicast, Transport: {Protocol: RTSP}}) where the profile token comes from GetProfiles. The device returns a device-specific RTSP URL (e.g. rtsp://<ip>:554/Streaming/Channels/101). ONVIF defines the MECHANISM (GetStreamUri), not a fixed URI — read the URI the device reports.
AUTH: WS-UsernameToken with Digest is the standard for ONVIF devices.
PROFILES: S (basic live streaming/PTZ), T (advanced video, H.265, HTTPS, metadata), G (edge storage/recording/playback), A (access-control config), C (door control). S and T are the camera-streaming ones this registry uses.

openness.notes: Published open standard maintained by the ONVIF forum. The facts here are from the onvif-python client documentation and the ONVIF media-service spec; nothing was reverse-engineered.
